classification: one-shot least-privilege construction boundary probe; fake IPC-shaped bytes only
hypothesis: On the Docker Desktop Windows-backed bind mount, a root container can assign an IPC-shaped file to the actual WSL host broker UID/GID 1002:1002 while retaining mode 0600, allowing only that owner to read it.
treatment_delta_from_02: After writing the same fake request, container root calls chown(1002,1002) and chmod(0600). No request prompt or model data is present.

decision.pass: Container exit 0, file owner observed as 1002:1002 and mode 0600, WSL host UID 1002 reads exact bytes/hash, and container is removed.
decision.stop: Any chown/chmod failure, owner/mode mismatch, host read/hash mismatch, or cleanup discrepancy. Preserve first outcome and do not retry.

security_limit: This synthetic owner-only treatment is only a permission-boundary test. It does not prove the production runner can safely discover/receive the host UID or that every Docker Desktop platform preserves chown semantics.
